sources.publisher: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
sources.documentTitle: Receipts Budget 2025-26: Annex-4 - Statement showing state-wise distribution of net proceeds of union taxes and duties
sources.notes: Cited ONLY for the Fifteenth Finance Commission horizontal share percentages in column 3. The rupee amounts this document prints are budget estimates for 2025-26 and are deliberately NOT used anywhere in this dataset. The share percentages are not estimates: they are fixed by the Commission for the whole 2021-22 to 2025-26 award period, so they apply to any year in it. Cross-checked against the 2022-23 and 2024-25 editions and identical in all three. This edition is cited because its text layer renders all 28 state rows; in the other two the Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra rows are corrupted and cannot be read mechanically.
sources.verificationNote: Kept as a cross-reference, not as the source of any figure. The Fifteenth Finance Commission's inter se shares are cited to the Commission's own report (Table 6.5); this Ministry of Finance restatement agrees with it exactly and is what the shares were originally read from, so it is worth being able to check. Marked unstable so nothing can cite it: it is a single year's Receipts Budget and would misrepresent the other years.

sources.publisher: Fifteenth Finance Commission, Government of India
sources.documentTitle: Report of the Fifteenth Finance Commission for 2021-26, Volume I: Main Report
sources.notes: Cited ONLY for Table 10.4, the state-wise revenue deficit grants, whose 2024-25 column totals 24,483 crore — identical to the actual the Notes on Demands print for the same head. That exact agreement is what makes an award table usable as an actual here, and it is specific to this grant: the Commission's other grants are conditional, so releases fall short of the award and their state-wise tables must NOT be read as actuals. This is a completed award for 2021-26, not a forecast, which is why status is actual-final despite being a recommendation document. Roughly 30 MB; sources:fetch will be slow.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
sources.documentTitle: Expenditure Profile 2026-27: Statement 15 - Position of Major Reserve Funds operated in Public Account
sources.notes: The only published statement naming the schemes each cess-financed reserve fund pays for. Cited for the three funds that receive the Health and Education Cess: Prarambhik Shiksha Kosh, Madhayamik and Uchchatar Shiksha Kosh, and Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Nidhi. IMPORTANT: this statement carries no actuals column — only RE 2025-26 and BE 2026-27 — so it can never support an actual-final figure. That is a limit of the publication, not of the extraction: the government does not report what cess money was actually spent on. The RE 2025-26 columns are used; 'amount transferred' and 'amount met' are identical in every row of all three funds. Unprefixed current-budget path, same caveat as the other /doc/eb/ sources.
